title: Complete e2e FLA read/write compatibility with Flash 8 based on spec 21
description:
DONE (agent-1205, 2026-06-19). GROUND-TRUTH NARROWING: the FLA read/write stack is extremely mature (5237 baseline core tests pass; writer is byte-perfect for empty docs per empty-bytematch). VERIFIED the true remaining writer round-trip gap via the importer<->writer field cross-reference: the §11 CPicFrame sound sub-block was hardcoded to ALL ZEROS in timeline-write.ts (soundId, pointCount/envelope, soundLoop, soundSync, inPoint, outPoint, soundZoom), so every frame sound attachment was silently dropped on save even though the model carries Frame.sound (SoundLinkage) and flash8-binary.ts parseFrame decodes it.

IMPLEMENTED: writeFrameSound() in packages/core/src/fla/write/timeline-write.ts emits the real §11 sound fields from frame.sound: soundId=mediaNumById.get(libraryItemId), custom-envelope point list, soundLoop=repeatCount, soundSync byte (event/start/stop/stream=0/1/2/3, inverse of import SOUND_SYNC_MODES), inPoint/outPoint. isEmptyKeyframe() now returns false when frame.sound is set so a sound-on-empty-keyframe takes the full path (the empty template hardcodes zeros). createDocument frames have sound:null so empty-bytematch is unaffected.

VERIFICATION (strongest available oracle = the importer's own binary reader):
- 5 new tests in real-fla-write.test.ts assert the written Page stream round-trips through parseFla8Timeline: soundId=1, soundSync=1 (start), soundLoop=3, inPoint=100, outPoint=5000; all 4 syncModes map to 0/1/2/3; a 2-point custom envelope round-trips point-for-point; soundless keyframe writes soundId 0; sound-bearing keyframe still passes the STRICT carchive-validate validator (classes == CPicFrame/CPicLayer/CPicPage).
- Command: (cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/fla/__tests__/real-fla-write.test.ts) => 14 passed.
- Full core FLA suite: (cd packages/core && npx vitest run src/fla) => 322 passed, ONLY the 3 pre-existing failures from missing fixtures/flash8-empty.fla (task 1207, ACCEPTABLE per task). Full core suite 5242 passed (was 5237 + 5 new). @flash/swf 1373 passed. All packages typecheck/build clean.

REMAINING GAP (split off to task 1224-3hv4g0): the writer does not emit the Contents CMediaSound/CMediaBits media-catalog records, so a full tryLoadRealFla re-import cannot resolve soundId -> libraryItemId (warns 'frame sound id N not found in library'). The frame-sound BYTES are correct; only the Contents library link is not yet rebuilt. That catalog work is byte-unverified vs a real Flash 8 oracle (risks the CONTENTS_POST_STAGE template) so it is correctly a separate high-effort story, not guessed here.

Docs: CLAUDE.md 'Binary FLA writer' section updated with the frame-sound write + the isEmptyKeyframe coupling + the remaining catalog gap. docs/21 §11 already documents the read-side layout the writer now matches; no spec change needed.
